original.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's policy push on critical minerals and rare-earths, as reported in February 2026:
items: In 2023, India classified more than 20 minerals as critical to its aim of self-reliance.
The USD 800mn incentive scheme approved in November 2025 targets 6,000 tonnes of permanent magnets annually within three years.
The Union Budget 2026-27 announced Dedicated Rare-Earth Corridors to cluster mining, processing, R&D and manufacturing.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong: the scheme targets 6,000 tonnes of permanent magnets annually within seven years, not three. The rare-earth corridors aim to shorten timelines, ease approvals and give investors predictable infrastructure.
original.source: In November 2025, it approved an USD 800mn incentive scheme targeting 6,000 tonnes of permanent magnets annually within seven years.
